name: Checker-Mnemonic
description: Python-based crypto wallet analytics tool for public addresses across Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain, Polygon, and EVM networks. Features multi-threaded scanning, portfolio aggregation, USD valuation, token discovery, and TXT/CSV/JSON exports for blockchain research and auditing. No private keys or seed phrases required.

name: Nudge
description: An app that shows edge pops/animation when you press side buttons, and a custom volume slider inspired by a concept design is now a reality

name: infamous2-recomp
description: inFamous 2 (PS3) statically recompiled to a native Windows PC port, with a launcher that builds it from your own game files. No game files included.

name: Polymarket-Prediction-Bot
description: Polymarket trading bot for prediction markets — browse CLOB markets, watch the order book in the terminal, run edge detection, liquidity provision and cross-market arbitrage strategies with paper trading and risk limits. Educational open-source toolkit — not financial advice. Unofficial community project, not affiliated with Polymarket.

description: OSINT geolocation tool for Windows: find where a photo or video was taken from the shadows, signs and other clues in the frame.

name: sitrep
description: One live console to monitor Claude Code and Codex agents across machines, track context and spend, and unblock sessions that need you.
